result.summary: The page is generally visually polished and functional. The main visible issue is intentional-looking horizontal carousel content being clipped at the right edge, which may appear broken without a clear scroll cue.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right, with only part of the next chip visible. The 'Fastest near you' carousel also cuts off the third restaurant card and its title at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Confirm that these rows are horizontally scrollable and add a subtle scroll affordance, or adjust card widths and spacing so the layout ends cleanly within the viewport.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, making its content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the page can scroll far enough that cards are not hidden behind the fixed navigation bar.
